tools.name: show_styles
tools.description: The illustration styles with an example picture of each, so the user can choose.

tools.name: create_book_plan
tools.description: Makes the plan for the book and returns the link to the order form on the website with the occasion and story line filled in. The parent then enters the child's name and photo there.

tools.name: list_occasions
tools.description: Occasions (birthday, Christmas, Sinterklaas, new sibling, bedtime story...) with ready-made storylines for a personalised children's book, in the user's language. The stories suit children of about 2 to 8. Do not ask for the child's age, name or photo: just ask which story they like.
